tidbit: Did you know… about 15,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Google DeepMind has unveiled Genie 4, a real-time world model designed for interactive 3D simulations. Reported by Analytics India Magazine.
Anthropic has accelerated drug discovery using Claude to identify issues humans miss, cutting review time by 89%. Confirmed per India Today.
Cloudera launches Blueprints, bringing NVIDIA Agent Toolkit to enterprises across cloud, data centres and edge environments. Reported by iTWire.
Meta has rolled out consumer artificial intelligence agent Muse in Singapore, featuring app integrations and privacy safeguards. Confirmed by The Business Times.
OpenAI has released 2 new open weight models for edge and data centers, responding to industry demand. Reported by TechTarget.
Free every hour.
